title: 1990 Landcruiser Prado 70 series Build
ai_summary: This 1990 LJ78 build thread documents a 1KZ-TE swap replacing the original 2L-T, while keeping the stock LJ78 manual gearbox, ECU, and wiring harness (which the builder himself calls 'a bit of an abomination'). Differentials were upgraded to KZJ78-spec units for a slightly higher ratio and to gain rear diff-lock capability, and the truck runs 31-inch Yokohama A/T tires. The vehicle remained a functioning daily driver used for river crossings and rock crawling, though the builder reported ongoing fuel-delivery underperformance affecting acceleration.

complications.detail: Original LJ78 ECU and wiring retained despite the 1KZ-TE swap, creating a mismatched setup; also recurring seal-beam headlight fuse blowing
Fuel delivery system underperformance reducing acceleration versus expectations; rear axle seal failure addressed during the build
